Thanks for your interest in Promocean Cloud, the hosted version of this platform.

A comment or a reaction on this issue is enough to join the waitlist. If you're
willing, a couple of details help us prioritize:

- **What are you building?** (product / site, roughly)
- **Expected monthly active users?** (order of magnitude is fine)
- **Which parts matter most?** (achievements, offers, timed events, points/rewards)

We'll reply on this issue when early access opens. Self-hosting is documented in
the [README](../../README.md#quickstart) today and stays free and unmetered.
